name: Shadowy Construct and Ichor Globule have AzerothCore's health, not a x1000 modifier (#8392)
contract: #8392: Shadowy Construct (23111) and Ichor Globule (29321) carried HealthModifier 1000, so they had about 7 and
11 million health. AzerothCore's base data gives 5.95 and 0.181802. On this realm's stats the Construct
(level 70 Warrior class, expansion 1: 6986 base health) has 6986 x 5.95 = 41567 health, and the Globule (level
76 Paladin class, expansion 2: 11001 base health) has 11001 x 0.181802 = 2000 health. The Globule is summoned
inside Violet Hold, because its script reads the Violet Hold instance.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the Shadowy Construct has 6986 x 5.95 = 41567 health, within 5%
